description: LATE BOX ARRIVALS 8 - MARKER TOLERANCE. The strict params set allows a second-line run only if 0x1442f8c70 (opponents in a 30x30 region ahead, sampled at 0.5) returns at most 1; the permissive set allows 2. Raises the strict cap to 2 so it matches the permissive set. One private imm8 (mov cl,1 -> mov cl,2). The exact meaning of the 0x1442f8c70 return is inferred; the direction (larger byte = more permissive) is not. Revert: python tools/exe_patch.py remove tools/data/patches/latebox-markers.json
